usage: fleet-switchboard labels apply-from-markers [-h] [--repo OWNER/REPO]
                                                   [--dry-run | --apply]

Lists the open PRs and issues of the watched repos (or --repo) whose first
non-empty body line says `MERGE: captain` or `MERGE: automatic` and which
carry NO merge label, and prints what would change. Without --apply nothing is
written (the default, same as --dry-run). With --apply it ensures the labels
exist and adds `<user>:merge-captain` / `<user>:merge-automatic` with the
repo's own gh account, audited. It is a person's command: the daemon never
runs it, and the sweep and triage still write nothing.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --repo OWNER/REPO  Only this repo
  --dry-run          Print what would change and write nothing (the default)
  --apply            Add the labels
